summary: Verified iteration_7 HIGH bug fix: ManpowerIn now accepts extension_rope_expiry_date and ppe_register_expiry_date. POST persists both, GET returns them, PUT updates them, and the Renewals page shows the Extension Rope and PPE Register badges for manpower expiring within 30 days.
passed: POST /api/manpower with extension_rope_expiry_date=+15d and ppe_register_expiry_date=+20d -> 200, both fields present in response (no longer dropped)
GET /api/manpower/{id} -> 200, both date fields returned with correct values
PUT /api/manpower/{id} updating extension_rope_expiry_date=+10d and ppe_register_expiry_date=+25d -> 200, response reflects updated values
Frontend Renewals page (/renewals) renders test manpower row with badges 'Extension Rope · 9d left' and 'PPE Register · 24d left'
